Subject: Internship Offer – {{ doc.designation or "" }}

Dear {{ doc.applicant_name or "" }},

It is our great pleasure to welcome you to Craft Interactive Technologies Pvt Ltd as a {{ doc.designation or "" }}! Your internship will begin on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.offer_date) if doc.offer_date else "" }} and will run for a period of three (3) months.

As a growing organization, we value flexibility, creativity, and a hands-on approach. Your primary role will be in Software Development, with the opportunity to explore and contribute to other areas that align with your interests and skills. This could include operations, marketing, communications, or other key aspects of our growing business.

You will receive a monthly stipend of ₹ {{ "%.2f"|format(doc.gross_salary) if doc.gross_salary else "" }} during your internship.

At the end of the three-month period, your performance, learning curve, and attitude will be reviewed. Based on this, we may offer you a full-time position at Craft. We’re looking for individuals who are proactive, adaptable, and excited about building something meaningful from the ground up.

We look forward to your valuable contribution and hope to see you grow with Craft over the long term.

Regards

Suresh Kumar

Director
